projects/patchpad-editor-v3 (instruction.md, environment/assets/instructions/editing.md, conflict-safety.md, file list) as closest sibling
evidence: The task is authored for a distinct product: task.toml describes 'A browser code playground with a custom editor, formatting, multiple carets, isolated preview and saved revisions' with arena_slice 'custom-code-editor-formatting-preview-history', unique among sibling task.toml slices in projects/ (closest sibling patchpad-editor-v3 uses 'full-stack-node-express-sqlite-custom-editor' for an incident-report editor). The brief is first-person and product-specific (instruction.md: 'paste a long one-line experiment, format it ... run it beside the source'; behaviour.md five-second run budget, last-good picture restore, Stop/newer-run supersession, idempotent restore over visible HTTP; security.md preview cannot fetch localhost/127.0.0.1 and refuses eval/Function/WebAssembly/workers/dynamic import), and app_context.md names Colderwater consistently with no stray sibling nouns (grep for patchpad/incident/gridforge/hireops/CHANGE_ME/TODO in the frozen task returned nothing; all template CHANGE_ME fields are replaced). Overlap with patchpad-editor-v3 is real but domain-inherent: about 14 of 44 functional criteria share editor-core themes (custom surface, grapheme movement, multi-caret, block Tab indent with next-line exclusion, find wrap, atomic Replace All, stale save keeps draft), yet 30 functional criteria are playground-specific (JS/HTML semantic colouring, idempotent JS/HTML formatting and format-error handling, run output, HTML preview, error/rejection line numbers, console ordering, interaction budgets, last-good and time-limit recovery, Stop, newer-run supersession, preview isolation, dynamic-code refusal, restore idempotency, live library updates preserving caret/scroll/undo). Counterexample probe: a renamed patchpad build could pass only the editor-core subset and would score 0 on all Run/preview/format/colouring criteria, so this is not a nouns-swapped clone; a conforming alternative is not penalised by this row. No runtime evidence is needed for this source-level row; provenance 'Adapted from the supplied Colderwater playground task' indicates client-supplied concept rather than sibling cloning.
